pages.text: Blast stove blocks join like Create fluid tanks: place them next to and on top of each other and they merge into one stove.

$(li)$(item)Width$(): 1x1 or $(item)2x2$() at most.$(li)$(item)Height$(): as tall as Create's fluid tank height limit (server config, 32 by default).$(br2)Whatever its size, the stove has four tanks of $(item)8000 mB$(): air in, fuel in, hot air out, CO2 out. Goggles show all four.

$(l)Size is speed$()$(br)The stove runs one cycle, then waits before the next. Each cycle converts $(item)one share per block$(), and the wait gets shorter as the stove grows. Output therefore grows with the $(item)square$() of the block count: double the blocks, about four times the hot air.
A stove is only a few blocks from useless to plenty. The view shows the size that matches one blast furnace making steel: $(item)2x2 wide, 5 high$().
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
